resources.string: TransRead Update Helper
This is the update helper. After preparation, Android still installs TransRead. The installed TransRead version is verified; books and notes stay in TransRead.
Android will ask you to confirm the installation. After updating, you can uninstall this helper in system settings. Other base versions require the full APK.
Prepare update
Preparing and verifying the update…
Update prepared. Continue to install TransRead and confirm on the system screen.
Allow TransRead %1$s installation
Install update
Complete the installation in the system confirmation screen, then return here to open TransRead.
Updated
TransRead is already on this or a newer version. You can open it and uninstall this helper.
Open TransRead
Install the full TransRead APK first, then use this helper for a matching update.
